Validate /pricing page renders 1:1 with https://boldteq.com/pricing.

Workspace: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq
Existing Playwright config: playwright.config.ts (root). Existing tests in tests/.

Recent changes (just shipped):
- Hero h1 split into two lines via `<br className="brDesktopOnly" />` (desktop only)
- Hero font-size 50px scoped under .newPriceSecPage modifier
- Pricing card button padding 9→10px
- Eyebrow badge bg = #effafe
- Removed .pricingTabLinkMonthly width override (all 3 tabs same min-width)
- ROI calc constants moved to lib/constants/pricing.ts; type renamed annual→annually

Tasks:
1. Start dev server in background: `cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq" && pnpm dev` — wait for localhost:3000 ready.
2. Write new spec at tests/pricing-parity.spec.ts that:
   a. Loads http://localhost:3000/pricing
   b. Asserts h1 contains "Pick a Flexible Subscription." and "Get Predictable Output."
   c. Asserts 3 pricing cards visible with `$999/month`, `$1999/month`, `$3499/month`
   d. Click Quarterly → asserts visible `$899/month`, `$1799/month`, `$3149/month` and struck `$999.00`, `$1999.00`, `$3499.00`
   e. Click Annually → asserts `$799/month`, `$1599/month`, `$2799/month` and struck originals
   f. CTA labels: monthly = 3× "Choose Plan"; quarterly/annually = 3× "Get Started"
   g. CTA hrefs contain `portal.boldteq.com/services/{plan}`
   h. Comparison table renders 9 data rows
   i. ROI calculator section present
   j. Screenshots at viewports 1440, 1280, 991, 767, 479 to test-results/pricing-{viewport}.png
3. Run `pnpm test:e2e tests/pricing-parity.spec.ts` and report pass/fail.
4. If any assertion fails diagnose root cause + file:line — DO NOT fix, just diagnose.

Constraints:
- Background-mode dev server, kill at end
- Report under 300 words: pass count, fail diagnoses, screenshot paths.

**Failure diagnoses (do not fix):**

**Test 5 & 6 — quarterly tab click (strict mode violation)**
Root cause: `getByRole("button", { name: /quarterly/i })` resolves to 2 elements — the pricing section toggle AND the ROI calculator's own billing toggle both contain a "Quarterly" button. Playwright's strict mode refuses to click an ambiguous selector.
File: `tests/pricing-parity.spec.ts:49` and `:64`
Fix needed: Scope the click to the pricing section's button group using `getByLabel("Billing period", { exact: true }).getByRole("button", { name: /quarterly/i })`.

**Test 10 — ROI calculator section not found**
Root cause: The ROI calculator component (`src/components/pricing/roi-calculator.tsx`) renders no element with a `class`, `id`, or `data-testid` containing "roi" (CSS Modules hash the class names). The fallback text scan for `/roi|return on investment|calculate/i` also finds nothing visible — likely either the ROI section heading uses different copy, or the section is below the fold and the `networkidle` wait for non-screenshot tests isn't triggered (domcontentloaded is used for this test).
File: `tests/pricing-parity.spec.ts:108`
Fix needed: Inspect the actual rendered heading text in `roi-calculator.tsx` and use that exact string, or add a `data-testid="roi-calculator"` to the section wrapper.
